Title: Auto-create report on shift running
Description: Automatically create a report for a shift when it transitions to the running state

Title: Bartender access to running shift report
Description: Allow bartenders assigned to a running shift to open and view its report

Title: Populate report with task template checklist
Description: Fill the report with tasks from the currently active task template

Title: Mark individual tasks as completed
Description: Allow bartenders to check off individual tasks within a shift report

Title: Add free-text notes to report
Description: Allow bartenders to add free-text notes to a shift report

Title: Auto-complete report when all tasks done
Description: Mark the report as done when all checklist tasks are completed

Title: CRUD task templates
Description: Allow managers to create; edit; and delete task templates with ordered task items

Title: Set active task template
Description: Allow managers to designate one task template as the active template for new reports

Title: Delete non-active task template
Description: Allow managers to delete a task template only if it is not the currently active one

Title: View completed reports
Description: Allow managers to view completed reports for any closed shift

Title: Show task completion details in report
Description: Display which bartender completed each task and the timestamp in completed reports

Title: Lock report after shift closes
Description: Make reports read-only once the associated shift transitions to closed
